text: Cell Neurobiology & Imaging Incub8 Incub8™ Multiwell MEA System The Incub8™ Multiwell MEA System enables simultaneous electrophysiology and optical assessment in a single recording - from inside a humidified CO₂ incubator. Designed by Multi Channel Systems, it delivers stable, true-to-life data with up to 768 simultaneous samples, making it ideal for drug screening, developmental biology, and sensitive cell models like iPSC-derived cells and organoids. Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging MEA2100-Mini MEA2100-Mini-Systems Compact, scalable in vitro MEA recording system with 60/120-channel headstages, 24-bit resolution at 50 kHz/channel, and support for up to 8 parallel headstages for high-throughput electrophysiology. Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging CMOS-MEA5000 CMOS-MEA5000-System High-resolution CMOS-based in vitro recording system with 4225 electrodes, 1024 stimulation sites, and 25 kHz per-channel sampling for sub-cellular electrophysiology. Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging STG5 STG5 Stimulus Generator Compact, scalable voltage and current stimulus generator with 2–8 galvanically isolated channels, 16 mA output range, 5 µs reaction time, and intuitive MC_Stimulus III software. Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging Roboocyte2 Roboocyte2 Fully-automated all-in-one system for medium throughput TEVC screening of ligand-gated and voltage-gated ion channels and electrogenic transporters using the Xenopus oocyte expression system. Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging MEA Microelectrode Arrays (MEA) ISO 9001:2015 certified Microelectrode Arrays (MEAs) available with 32–252 TiN electrodes, Multiwell plates for 24/96-well drug screening, and flexible FlexMEAs for in vivo recordings - compatible with MEA2100, CMOS-MEA5000, and more. Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging EVM-MT-03-02 EVOM™ Manual – TEER Measurement Meter The EVOM™ Manual is WPI's next-generation manual TEER meter - replacing the EVOM3, EVOM2, and MilliCell® ERS-2. Features automatic data logging, 20X sample averaging, adjustable currents (2, 4, or 10 μA), and resistance auto-ranging from 1 Ω to 100,000 Ω for reliable epithelial and endothelial barrier measurements. Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging VAR-1953 Standard Glass Capillaries WPI Standard Glass Capillaries are high-purity borosilicate tubes for pulling precision micropipettes used in patch clamp, intracellular recording, and microinjection. Available in 1.0–2.0 mm OD and 3, 4, or 6-inch lengths, with or without internal filament, they are compatible with all standard pullers including the WPI PUL-1000. Glass Capillaries Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging VAR-3093 WPI Manual Micromanipulator The WPI M3301 is the world's most widely used manual micromanipulator, trusted in thousands of neuroscience and cell biology labs for patch clamp recording, intracellular electrophysiology, and microinjection. Weighing just 550 g with 10 μm X-axis fine resolution and drift-free rack-and-pinion drive, it delivers precision positioning up to 250x magnification in a compact, space-saving form factor. Micromanipulator Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging VAR-3220 Peri-Star Pro Peristaltic Pump The WPI Peri-Star Pro is an affordable, high-performance digital peristaltic pump covering 0.1–280 mL/min across 2, 4, or 8-channel configurations. With 0.5% flow accuracy, planetary gear-driven low-pulsation rollers, and built-in self-calibration, it is the standard choice for brain slice perfusion, organ perfusion, and cell culture under flow in neuroscience and cell biology labs. Peristaltic Pump Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging uM-Patch Sensapex uM Patch Clamp Workstations The Sensapex uM Patch Clamp Workstations are fully integrated, automated electrophysiology systems combining the uMs motorized microscope, uMp ZERO DRIFT™ micromanipulators, and uMc pressure controllers. Modular and scalable, they automate the most laborious steps in patch clamp, microinjection, and single-cell analysis - from classic manual setups to fully automated multi-pipette workflows. Patch Clamp Workstation Read More

Cell Neurobiology & Imaging uMs-FN1 Sensapex uMs Microscope The Sensapex uMs is a purpose-built upright microscope for slice patch clamp electrophysiology and advanced imaging. Based on the Nikon FN-1 platform extended with Sensapex’s closed-loop motion control expertise, it delivers 4 nm resolution and 100 nm repeatability on all axes, providing the stability, accuracy, and smooth motion required for demanding multi-patch and high-speed imaging experiments.
